extracted.intended_audience: publishers, creators, brands, and Flipboard users interested in editorial products
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and product-description for creating and curating Flipboard editorial franchises — the design, curation, partner integration, sponsorship, cadence, and storytelling expectations for platform destinations like The Daily Edition, The Culturist, Vote 2018, 10 For Today, and The Insight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative arc (beginning, middle and end)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each editorially curated franchise is filled with articles and videos that take the audience on a journey, with a beginning, middle and an end.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories should be arranged with a clear narrative arc so readers can browse topically while experiencing a coherent journey; used as a design principle across franchises and explicitly cited for Vote 2018 to make readers fully informed and ready to take action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Point-of-view curation & diversity
rubrics_metrics.description: “We believe that curation is at its best when it represents a point of view, and we want to be a platform for diverse perspectives that enables the world to tell its best stories.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curations should represent a clear editorial point of view and include diverse perspectives; partner contributions (e.g., NYT, WaPo, Axios) are used to add expert/diverse voices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brand design and aesthetic to express unique voice and tone
rubrics_metrics.description: Each of the franchises has its own brand design and aesthetic to express its unique voice and tone, representing its ethos.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design and visual identity should reflect the franchise’s ethos and tone (examples: The Culturist's colorful imagery; 10 For Today’s tone of curiosity and serendipity).

rubrics_metrics.name: Visual layout elements (bold background, hero image, collection description)
rubrics_metrics.description: The new layouts are built on a bold black background with a hero image and a description of the collection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use striking visuals (hero image) and clear collection descriptions to introduce the franchise; visual treatment supports the brand voice and signals quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section organization and scannability
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories are organized into sections, letting people quickly dive in and navigate to the most interesting or important topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organize content into clearly labeled sections (e.g., politics, candidates, ads, numbers, analysis) to improve discoverability and rapid navigation within a franchise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness / continuous curation
rubrics_metrics.description: The Daily Edition is a pillar of Flipboard’s news curation, offering a rundown of the biggest stories of the day, carefully curated 24/7 by our global News Desk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For news-focused franchises prioritize 24/7 updating and rapid curation to ensure audiences are prepared for the day ahead; maintain a global news desk or equivalent workflow for continuous coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical breadth and category coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Flipboard has built one of the world’s most popular mobile destinations for people’s interests, covering major events, cultural trends and popular topics, particularly in news, technology, sports, and lifestyle categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Franchises should cover a relevant breadth of categories for their audience (e.g., The Daily Edition’s sections on news, business, tech, sports, celebrity) to provide comprehensive context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of partner and publisher contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: These five franchises include contributions from category-leading publishers that bring a unique perspective or depth to a topic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feature dedicated sections from partners (NYT, Washington Post, Axios) to add diverse expert voices and editorial depth; use publisher features to enrich content and credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Update cadence and newsletter integration
rubrics_metrics.description: The Culturist... is updated on Tuesdays and Saturdays with what to watch, listen to, and talk about. An accompanying email will ensure users never miss a beat.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define a clear publishing cadence for each franchise and integrate email/newsletter touchpoints to retain and re-engage users.

rubrics_metrics.name: Curated listicle format (10 For Today: series of 10 stories)
rubrics_metrics.description: WITH millions of people reading 10 For Today in their email inbox, this series of 10 stories is now a beautiful collection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use constrained, repeatable formats (e.g., '10 stories') to create a recognizable, digestible product; align tone and aesthetic with the format’s intent (curiosity, serendipity).

rubrics_metrics.name: Tone and editorial intent (curiosity, serendipity, essential reading)
rubrics_metrics.description: 10 For Today is essential reading for anyone who strives to expand their worldview… The tone and aesthetic treatment for 10 For Today reflect the curiosity and serendipity that’s core to the franchise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Match tone and aesthetic to editorial intent: e.g., curiosity-driven collections should feel exploratory and serendipitous; industry-focused franchises should feel authoritative and data-informed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry focus and data-driven audience insights (The Insight)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Insight is an industry-focused destination for advertising and media professionals... The Insight is also the home for audience insights from Flipboard’s Data Science Team.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For professional/industry franchises emphasize expert curation, proprietary data or insights, and content that informs practitioners’ work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsorship placement and brand-safe environment
rubrics_metrics.description: With an exclusive sponsorship space to associate with quality, editorially curated stories, brands have a place to connect with influential audiences in a beautifully designed, brand-safe environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clearly defined sponsorship inventory adjacent to curated content and ensure environments are brand-safe to attract advertiser investment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discovery and surfacing of overlooked stories
rubrics_metrics.description: Helping people browse topics they care about and discover stories they otherwise might have missed in the daily deluge of content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curation should prioritize surfacing high-quality or overlooked content that aligns with readers’ interests, combating information overload through editorial selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publisher value: driving traffic and new audience exposure
rubrics_metrics.description: These publisher feature sections also drive value to the publisher through increased traffic and new audience exposure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design franchise features and partner placements to measurably drive referral traffic and audience growth for publishing partners as part of the value proposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection for high-impact storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: This franchise highlights great storytelling, the kind that has led to breakthroughs and advancements, changed our politics and views on society, and just made us laugh.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize stories with narrative power or demonstrable cultural impact; select pieces that inform, persuade, inspire, or entertain in meaningful ways.
